topology: 1 node x4 H100, NVSHMEM sparse pairs with heavy-tailed weights
workload_note: `asym_patterns skew 4096 3`. The edge set comes from a closed form — h = (mype*31 + peer*17) % 11, no edge when h < 5, count = slot >> (h-5) — rather than from an RNG, so it is identical on every run and every PE count: a capture you cannot reproduce is not a fixture. Roughly half the ordered pairs carry no edge and the rest span 32x, which is what puts the matrix's log colour scale and the clustering metric under load. Directional: an edge i->j says nothing about j->i.
